description: Line 1 is a CONN close of connection 0 naming feed FORCE, recorded before its first valid open (no feed yet, so no CONN_FEED_CONFLICT). Line 2 is a MSG (ps_type anomaly, far outside V(tau)) of connection 0, recorded BEFORE connection 0 opens as KLINE (line 3). The feed applies from the first valid open on, so the message has no feed: MSG_CONN_UNKNOWN; it is treated as a FORCE message, so it is a replay input (ledger MALFORMED, no void: outside V) and its anomaly is reported by 7.7. The frames of connection 0 recorded after its open are KLINE frames and change nothing.
title: a MSG recorded before the first open of a connection that later opens as KLINE
